intent: Create a dark-mode toggle button component in HTML/CSS/JS.

spec.goal: Get a reusable dark-mode toggle button component that lets a user switch a page between light and dark appearance.
spec.deliverable: A dark-mode toggle button component built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including the code needed to use it on a web page.
constraints: Must be written in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Must be a button component that toggles dark mode.
Must be self-contained so it can be dropped into a page.
done_criteria: The component is delivered as HTML, CSS and JavaScript code.
Clicking the button switches the page between light mode and dark mode.
The button is visible and clearly shows or indicates the current mode.
The code runs in a browser without additional setup.
spec.summary: You want a dark-mode toggle button component built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript that switches a page between light and dark mode.
